Task CHORE-TEAM-TOOL-RECHECK-LOCAL-CRON (po triage 2026-08-06, decision=REPLACE the dead cloud-RemoteTrigger writer, do NOT retire; origin signal cj-20260806T085500). agent-father re-established the writer for the STATIC subset it can run without a gateway grant — see docs/agents/agent-father/flow/team-tool-recheck.md (new sub-flow, wired into keep.md Step 5b, runs on the existing daily cron-agent-father.md cadence, no new cron registration needed) — and produced the first health file docs/agent-memory/health/team-tool-recheck-2026-08-06-0739.md, which correctly flags the positive control (alert-commander Bash-vs-boundary mismatch, plus market-watcher/news-scout same class) required by the row's AC.

NOT reproducible by agent-father (no mcp__gateway__call_tool grant, confirmed .claude/agents/agent-father.md tools line): the historical writer's LIVE MCP-probe checks — tool param-name drift vs live schema (e.g. `ticker` vs `code` on get_technical_indicators/get_price_history/get_foreign_flow/get_ticker_intelligence, confirmed pattern from git history of the pre-2026-06-23 files), get_cron_health (cron success-rate/crash detection), get_vps_proxy_health/get_vps_service_health, get_system_status (unresolved runtime errors). Some of this overlaps system-auditor's existing Tier-1 (A-01..A-31 runtime health) and Tier-2 (B-01..B-13 freshness/VPS) dimensions already; the genuinely uncovered remainder is the tool-interface-schema-drift class (documented param name vs live-required param name) — no existing dimension checks that.

RECOMMENDATION: po assigns a gateway-bound owner for this remainder (system-auditor extension as a new lightweight dimension, or a dedicated small periodic check) rather than reviving the old ~2h cloud-RemoteTrigger cadence verbatim — that cadence was sized for live-incident response; the now-separated static compliance check (agent-father, daily) doesn't need that granularity, but a schema-drift class does benefit from higher frequency than daily if it's picked up. Not blocking — the static subset (this row's positive-control AC) is satisfied independent of this remainder.
